quests.name: Trouble with Giant Spiders
quests.summary: The banker wants the giant spider near Eloreach thinned out.
intro: The giant spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Eloreach and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Lobster
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Eloreach has run out of raw lobster.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 21 raw lobster and nobody in Eloreach has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Clothes Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Eloreach to the clothes shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the clothes shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the General Store Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the general store keeper of Eloreach and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the general store keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Eloreach Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Eloreach Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Eloreach Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders

quests.name: Short on Maple Logs
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Eloreach has run out of maple logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 26 maple logs and nobody in Eloreach has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Banker
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Eloreach to the banker.
intro: This should have gone to the banker days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Eloreach Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Eloreach Sewers and tell the food shop keeper.
intro: Eloreach Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the food shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Eloreach owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Eloreach Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Sarnwick
quests.summary: Gather raw lobster for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Sarnwick.
intro: I have an order from Sarnwick and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw lobster, then take the packed shipment to the general store keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Eloreach.
From Eloreach? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Eloreach and bring back raw lobster.
intro: The wilds around Eloreach need a firm hand. Start with 13 giant spider outside the walls, then 21 giant rat down in Eloreach Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 21 raw lobster to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Eloreach for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Eloreach Sewers (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear crawling hand out of Eloreach Sewers and tell the fishing shop keeper.
intro: Eloreach Sewers is crawling with crawling hand, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the fishing shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Eloreach owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Eloreach Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 crawling hand fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

Bring me 16 big bones, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the magic shop keeper in Eloreach.

outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Eloreach for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the food shop keeper, fight your way through 31 giant spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 21 raw lobster back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Eloreach: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Eloreach Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Eloreach and Sarnwick.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Sarnwick. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 imp near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Eloreach.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Sarnwick is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Eloreach has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Eloreach
quests.summary: Find what rules Eloreach Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Eloreach Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the fishing shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Eloreach is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Eloreach Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
